quote: Given the prefix as the prompt, if an LLM is able to nearly reconstruct the suffix with greedy decoding, we say x is a memorized sequence by the LLM.
This paper studies whether we can localize a piece of memorized data, i.e., identify components in LLMs responsible for generating a sequence (near) verbatim.
outputs: The paper evaluates generated sequences in terms of verbatim memorization, focusing on suffix reconstruction given a prefix, measured via Accuracy and Levenshtein distance.

quote: Accuracy calculates the percentage of correct suffix tokens generated by teacher-forcing and argmax decoding. ... We calculate Levenshtein distance between the generated suffix ŝ and the true suffix s.

We quantify memorization with two scores: Accuracy and Levenshtein distance. Accuracy calculates the percentage of correct suffix tokens... Levenshtein distance ... Lower Levenshtein distance indicates better memorization. We also report perplexity changes ...
